summary.headline: Feature update policy guidance emphasizes ongoing management
summary.summary: The feature update policy description shifts from creating releases to managing Windows feature update policies in Intune.
summary.adminImpact: Treat feature version targeting as an ongoing policy-management activity rather than a one-time release creation task.

summary.headline: Windows feature update guidance adopts a management focus
summary.summary: The article is retitled Manage Windows feature updates and describes using Intune policies to manage Windows feature updates.
summary.adminImpact: Use the management guidance when setting and maintaining Windows feature version targets.

summary.headline: Archived Windows update references point to consolidated quality update guidance
summary.summary: Archive links for feature update reports and expedited quality updates now point to their current report and quality update guidance locations.
summary.adminImpact: Update saved references for expedited quality updates to the consolidated Windows quality update guidance.

summary.headline: Windows edition filter note is nested with its filter guidance
summary.summary: The Settings Catalog note explaining that Edge, Office, and OneDrive settings do not follow Windows OS version or edition filtering is indented beneath the relevant guidance.
summary.adminImpact: Do not expect Edge, Office, or OneDrive settings when filtering the catalog to a specific Windows edition.

summary.headline: Driver update policy creation flow is streamlined
summary.summary: Driver update policy guidance is dated January 13, 2026 and streamlines the initial navigation to Devices, Windows, Manage updates, Windows updates, Driver updates, then Create profile.
summary.adminImpact: Use the streamlined navigation path when creating a Windows driver update policy.
